passages.note: Bill text covers curriculum, budgets, libraries, vaccines and more; the consent clause concerns school forms, not staff use of names or pronouns, and records cannot seat a chair at this level.

rows.reasoning: The only evidence is Curtis's 2023 House Aye on H.R. 5 (118th), a multi-subject bill whose consent clause covers changing names or pronouns "on any school form" rather than staff use as in the rung "Require parental permission before staff use a different name or pronouns"; at the federal level this topic is own words only, so no record can seat a chair and no own-words passage is in the sources.
